liturgicalName: 34th Sunday: Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe
keyVerseDR: "...as long as you did it to one of these my least brethren, you did it to me." (Mt 25:40)

level1.title: Jesus Our King
level1.story: Jesus is our King. He said, "When you help people who are hungry, thirsty, or sick, you help Me!" We serve Jesus by serving others.
level1.keyLine: When I help, I love Jesus.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Who do we help when we help others?
level1.prayer: Jesus, my King, I serve You. Amen.

activity.title: Christ the King
activity.intro: Draw the other half of the King's crown.

level2.title: Christ the King
level2.story: Jesus said that when the Son of Man comes in glory, He will sit on His throne, and all the nations will be gathered before Him. He will separate them as a shepherd separates sheep from goats. To those on His right He will say, "I was hungry and you gave Me food; I was thirsty and you gave Me drink." They will ask, "Lord, when did we do this?" The King will answer, "As long as you did it to one of these My least brethren, you did it to Me."
level2.keyLine: As long as you did it to one of these my least brethren, you did it to me.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Jesus say helping others is helping Him?
Which work of mercy can you do this week?
level2.prayer: Christ the King, reign in my heart. Amen.

activity.title: Serving the King
activity.intro: Match each need to a work of mercy.

art.mainBrief: Christ the King on a simple throne; children feeding, visiting
art.heartBrief: Six works of mercy icons around heart
